JobDoneEvent.description:
WS /ws/queue. TranscriptionQueue sends these three as plain dicts;
tests hold them to these models.
JobDoneEvent.title: JobDoneEvent

JobUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /queue/jobs/{id}: only the fields sent are changed; language
null or "auto" = auto-detect.
JobUpdateRequest.title: JobUpdateRequest

RefusalResponse.description:
A refusal of the queue's job routes (400, and 409 for a job that started):
a message for the user and what it is about.
RefusalResponse.title: RefusalResponse

SpeakerAssignmentRequest.description:
The segments that change, all together, by their start, and exactly one of:
an existing speaker_id, or speaker_name to create a new speaker. color_index
sets the new speaker's palette color (only with speaker_name).
SpeakerAssignmentRequest.title: SpeakerAssignmentRequest

SpeakerAssignmentUndoRequest.description:
speaker_id is who the segments had: a voice removed by the assignment is not
in memory any more, or UNASSIGNED. created_speaker_id is the speaker the
assignment made, if it did.
SpeakerAssignmentUndoRequest.title: SpeakerAssignmentUndoRequest

SpeakerCandidate.description:
A known speaker that an unknown voice may be. score is cosine similarity,
not below 0. Only the first candidate can be suggested.
SpeakerCandidate.title: SpeakerCandidate

SpeakerResponse.description: A speaker in the Speakers section. name is None for unnamed speakers.
SpeakerResponse.title: SpeakerResponse

SpeakerUpdateRequest.description: At least one of name / color_index.
SpeakerUpdateRequest.title: SpeakerUpdateRequest

TranscribeRequest.description:
POST /queue/jobs. language null or "auto" = auto-detect; no title =
the file name without its extension.
TranscribeRequest.title: TranscribeRequest

TranscriptionModelInfo.description: GET /models: a Whisper or diarization model of the catalog.
TranscriptionModelInfo.title: TranscriptionModelInfo

UnknownSpeakerCandidates.description:
GET /transcripts/{id}/speaker-candidates, per speaker without a name. clip
is null when the audio file is gone.
UnknownSpeakerCandidates.title: UnknownSpeakerCandidates

VoiceClip.description: A segment of the transcript's own audio to hear an unknown voice.
VoiceClip.title: VoiceClip

WaveformResponse.description:
GET /transcripts/{id}/waveform: one height per bar, from 0 (silence) to 1
(the loud part of the recording).
WaveformResponse.title: WaveformResponse

post.description:
Store a live recording (raw body, Content-Type audio/webm or audio/wav)
in RECORDINGS_DIR. The backend is the only writer of that dir, so the UI
uploads instead of writing a file wherever its own data dir is.

Ready when the app may restart the backend now; otherwise what it waits
for. A running transcription finishes first and no new one starts.

delete.description: Delete a job and its audio (a running job is stopped first).

post.description: A live recording started: the queue pauses and the running job stops.
Call after queuing the new recording (it then goes last).

get.description:
Every speaker: with a voice profile, a name, or assigned segments.
Named speakers first (by name), then unnamed ones (most recently seen first).
Speakers that tie keep one order: the most recently seen first, then by id.

A segment to play as the speaker's voice: the one closest to their
voice profile whose audio file still exists (optionally within one transcript).

schema.title: Response Speaker Transcripts Speakers  Speaker Id  Transcripts Get

patch.description: Edit transcript metadata (title). Speakers and segments are untouched.

get.description:
The audio file of a recording, with Range requests for seeking. The path
comes from the database only.

404.description: No such transcript, or its audio file is gone

delete.description:
The user marked the transcript unread: it is listed as not opened until
POST /transcripts/{id}/opened. Only this flag changes.

post.description:
The user opened the transcript. Only this flag changes; GET /transcripts/{id}
leaves it alone, so repeated loads do not set it.

Give the listed segments one speaker, all or none. Nothing is created
until the request is known to be good.
A segment deleted since the assignment has nothing to go back to and is skipped.

get.description:
For each speaker without a name in the transcript: the known speakers
with the closest voice and a clip to hear it. Reads speaker memory only.

schema.title: Response Get Speaker Candidates Transcripts  Transcript Id  Speaker Candidates Get

get.description:
Heights for the player's waveform: bars evenly over [start, end) of the
recording, on the scale of the whole recording. The loudness is worked out
with ffmpeg on the first request (or after transcription) and cached next to
the audio.

parameters.description: Seconds; the end of the audio by default
parameters.name: end

schema.description: Seconds; the end of the audio by default
schema.title: End

404.description: No such transcript, or its audio file is gone

500.description: The audio could not be read
